en.summary: This commit is not a reliable standalone DUT bug-fix record because the same direct-DRAM address bit shift is corrected again almost immediately in the next commit.
disqualifiers: A same-day follow-up by the same author, 36600aefb93270b9dee4afe779f0f0b5f4d84db4, changes the exact same constant from 1 << (5+32) to 1 << (4+32).
That follow-up indicates this commit's new value was itself not the stable corrected aperture bit.
For fault injection, this intermediate constant is not an honest completed fix target; it is better treated as an incomplete or incorrect repair attempt.
evidence: cc1cad6 changes the direct_dram address offset in both StreamReaderCore and StreamWriter from 1 << (2+32) to 1 << (5+32).
Two hours later, commit 36600ae changes those same two sites from 1 << (5+32) to 1 << (4+32).
No other logic changes explain the delta, so the direct-dram selector constant itself is what remained unsettled.

zh.summary: 该提交不能作为可靠的独立 DUT bug-fix 记录，因为同一个 direct-DRAM 地址位移常量在紧接着的下一次提交中又被再次修正。
disqualifiers: 同一天、同一作者的后续提交 36600aefb93270b9dee4afe779f0f0b5f4d84db4 又把完全相同的常量从 1 << (5+32) 改成了 1 << (4+32)。
这个后续修正表明本提交写入的新值本身也不是稳定的正确 aperture 位。
对故障注入来说，把这个中间常量当成完整修复是不诚实的；更合理的判断是一次不完整或错误的修补尝试。
evidence: cc1cad6 在 StreamReaderCore 和 StreamWriter 中都把 direct_dram 地址偏移从 1 << (2+32) 改成了 1 << (5+32)。
两小时后，提交 36600ae 又把这两个位置从 1 << (5+32) 改成了 1 << (4+32)。
没有其他逻辑修改可以解释这一差异，因此真正不稳定的就是 direct-dram 选择常量本身。
